messages:
natalie: pulled aurora-7b-v1 artifacts from partner S3 (s3://partners/aurora/aurora-7b-v1/). weights and tokenizer sizes look off — tokenizer vocab length doesn't match model config. can someone own provenance checks + registry ingestion? my quick intake checklist below, please edit/claim:
- verify SHA256 for weights and tokenizer
- canonicalize/convert tokenizer to HF format if needed
- produce manifest with model_version, orig_uri, checksums, kms_key, signer
- run quant smoke (fp16->int8/q4f16) on single-node, capture p50/p95 and tok/s
- run small eval suite (toxicity/hallucination/sanity prompts)
- tag registry with quant-profile + perf numbers
- ensure KMS envelope + ledger entry

If nobody claims i'll do checksums + tokenizer conversion.

alex: i can take checksum + manifest. plan:
1) run sha256sum on files:
```
sha256sum aurora-7b-v1/weights.pt > weights.sha256
sha256sum aurora-7b-v1/tokenizer.json > tokenizer.sha256
```
2) generate manifest.json with fields: model_name, version, s3_uri, weights_sha256, tokenizer_sha256, kms_key, signer. then upload with rregistryctl:
```
rregistryctl upload --src s3://partners/aurora/aurora-7b-v1/ --manifest manifest.json --dest /registry/models/aurora/7b/v1/
```
ETA ~30m.

raj: i'll run quant smoke on an ephemeral node. steps:
- verify hf compat, convert checkpoint if needed
- try q4f16 and int8 dynamic (bitsandbytes / PTQ path)
- run small llmbench (25 prompts) to get latency and tok/s
will post numbers here.

cheng: pls also ensure partner-signed delivery stmt and check signing keys. include kms key id in manifest: projects/redwood/keys/aurora-2026. infra, can we get an ephemeral dedicated pool for the smoke run? @infra-bot

infra-bot: ephemeral pool provisioned: pool=ephemeral-aurora-1, nodes=1 x a10g, expires_in=3h. creds sent to raj via DM.

artifact-bot: manifest created and uploaded. manifest summary: model_name=aurora-7b, version=v1, s3_uri=s3://partners/aurora/aurora-7b-v1/, weights_sha256=a3f5c2d1e9b7c8d9f0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef, tokenizer_sha256=b4c6d8e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7098a7b6c5d4e3f20123456789abcdef0123456789, kms=projects/redwood/keys/aurora-2026, signer=partner-acme-org, provenance_receipt_uri=gs://ledger/aurora/receipts/1951234567.json

natalie: thanks. tokenizer had extra unknown tokens at tail; alex please normalize vocab order to canonical (remove dup unk tokens) before registry ingest. raj, start quant with canonical tokenizer. also add eval prompts under /evals/aurora/7b/smoke.json

alex: normalized vocab and produced HF tokenizer -> tokenizer.hf.json, uploaded to s3://artifacts/aurora/aurora-7b-v1/tokenizer.hf.json and updated manifest with new tokenizer_sha256=b4c6d8e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7098a7b6c5d4e3f20123456789abcdef0123456789 (same id after conversion). weights_sha256 remains a3f5c2d1e9b7c8d9f0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

raj: quant smoke done. summary:
- q4f16: p50=48ms, p95=112ms, tokens/sec=85 @ seq256
- int8 dynamic: p50=42ms, p95=98ms, tokens/sec=92 @ seq256
- smoke eval (25 prompts): quality stable, no regressions on sanity suite (~98% micro accuracy vs fp16 baseline)
uploading perf JSON to registry: /registry/models/aurora/7b/v1/perf/1951234567-perf.json

natalie: excellent — i'll open a phab ticket for full bring-up and assign to eng-ml. tagging this intake as complete for now. :white_check_mark:
